page.subtitle: Explore assets, prices and market data

native.title: What is a native asset?
native.body: A native asset is the built-in currency of a blockchain, it isn't issued by a company or backed by an off-chain reserve. It pays for transaction fees, secures the network, and acts as a bridge between other assets traded on-chain.

stablecoin.title: What is a stablecoin?
stablecoin.body: A stablecoin is a token designed to track the value of a reference currency such as the US dollar or the euro. Issuers hold reserves (cash, short-term government debt, or other safe instruments) so that each token can be redeemed 1:1, giving holders price stability with the speed and global reach of blockchain settlement.

sovereignBond.title: What is a tokenized sovereign bond?
sovereignBond.body: A tokenized sovereign bond represents a share of debt issued by a national government,for instance, US Treasuries or Mexican Government Bonds, wrapped into an on-chain token. Holders earn the underlying yield while keeping the liquidity and 24/7 transferability of a digital asset.

tokenizedFund.title: What is a tokenized fund?
tokenizedFund.body: A tokenized fund is a share of a regulated investment fund issued directly on-chain, where the token itself is the record of ownership rather than an IOU for one. The fund holds conventional assets, typically short-term government debt, and a transfer agent keeps the on-chain register in sync with the fund's books. Some share classes are restricted to investors the issuer has approved, so they can be tracked but not freely traded.

commodity.title: What is a tokenized commodity?
commodity.body: A tokenized commodity represents ownership of a physical asset, such as gold, held in professional vaults, wrapped into an on-chain token. Each token is redeemable against the underlying reserve, which is verified by independent audits, so holders get commodity price exposure with the liquidity and 24/7 transferability of a digital asset.

structuredCredit.title: What is structured credit?
structuredCredit.body: Structured credit pools many corporate loans into a single vehicle and splits the repayments into tranches ranked by who gets paid first. The AAA tranche sits at the top, absorbing losses last, which is why it carries the highest credit rating in the structure. Tokenizing that tranche puts an institutional fixed-income product on-chain, though the rating describes credit risk only, not price stability.

XLM.description: Native token of the Stellar network, used for fees and reserves
XLM.summary: XLM is the native currency of Stellar, a decentralized payment network built for fast, low-cost cross-border transfers. Every Stellar account must hold a minimum reserve in XLM, and each transaction costs a small fee (~0.00001 XLM). XLM also acts as a bridge currency between assets that lack a direct trading pair on the Stellar DEX.
highlights: Pays fees and the minimum reserve required to keep a Stellar account open
Used as a bridge currency for path payments between assets without a direct pair
Capped supply with no inflation since the 2019 community vote
3–5 second confirmation times and sub-cent transaction fees

USDC.description: Dollar-backed stablecoin issued by Circle, pegged 1:1 to USD
USDC.summary: USDC is a fully-reserved US dollar stablecoin issued by Circle. Each USDC is backed 1:1 by cash and short-term US Treasuries held in segregated accounts, audited monthly. On Stellar, Circle issues USDC natively, enabling near-instant, near-free dollar settlement for payments, remittances, and DeFi. USDC on Stellar is widely supported by wallets, exchanges, and anchors.
highlights: Backed 1:1 by cash and short-duration US Treasuries held with regulated custodians
Monthly attestations published by Deloitte covering reserve composition
Issued by Circle, a US-regulated money-services business
Natively redeemable through Circle Mint for verified institutional accounts

USDT0.description: Omnichain US dollar stablecoin connected to Tether's unified USDT supply
USDT0.summary: USDT0 brings Tether's USDT liquidity to Stellar through LayerZero's Omnichain Fungible Token standard. USDT is locked in the adapter on Ethereum and an equivalent amount of USDT0 is minted on the destination network, keeping one unified supply instead of creating isolated wrapped liquidity. On Stellar, USDT0 is a native classic asset with a Stellar Asset Contract interface.
highlights: Backed 1:1 by USDT held through the USDT0 adapter on Ethereum
Moves between Stellar and supported networks through LayerZero's OFT standard

EURC.description: Euro-backed stablecoin issued by Circle, pegged 1:1 to EUR
EURC.summary: EURC is Circle's MiCA-compliant euro stablecoin, fully backed 1:1 by euro-denominated reserves held in regulated financial institutions. It is redeemable at par and subject to monthly attestations. On Stellar, EURC enables low-cost euro payments and settlements across the global Stellar network.
highlights: First major euro stablecoin authorised under the EU's MiCA framework
Reserves held in segregated accounts with regulated European banks
Monthly third-party attestations confirm 1:1 backing
Designed for euro-area payments, FX flows, and on-chain settlement

USDY.description: Yield-bearing stablecoin backed by US Treasury bills and bank deposits
USDY.summary: USDY is Ondo Finance's tokenized yield-bearing instrument backed by short-term US Treasuries and bank demand deposits. Unlike traditional stablecoins, USDY accrues yield daily and is designed for non-US persons. The token uses a rebase mechanism so balances automatically reflect accrued interest. Not available to US persons.
highlights: Backed by short-duration US Treasuries and bank demand deposits
Yield accrues daily and is reflected in the token price
Issued by Ondo USDY LLC, a bankruptcy-remote special-purpose vehicle
Restricted from US persons under Regulation S

PYUSD.description: US dollar stablecoin issued by PayPal and Paxos, pegged 1:1 to USD
PYUSD.summary: PYUSD is PayPal's dollar-backed stablecoin issued by Paxos Trust Company. Each token is backed 1:1 by USD deposits and US Treasury bills, with monthly attestations published by an independent auditor. Originally launched on Ethereum, PYUSD expanded to Stellar for faster and cheaper settlement. Accessible through PayPal, Venmo, and a growing list of Stellar wallets and anchors.
highlights: Issued by Paxos Trust, a New York State–chartered limited-purpose trust
Backed 1:1 by US dollar deposits and short-term Treasury bills
Held and spent natively inside PayPal and Venmo by hundreds of millions of users
Monthly reserve reports published by an independent auditor

GYEN.description: Japanese yen stablecoin issued by GMO-Z.com Trust Company, pegged 1:1 to JPY
GYEN.summary: GYEN is the first regulated Japanese yen stablecoin, issued by GMO-Z.com Trust Company, a New York State-chartered limited purpose trust company. Each GYEN is backed 1:1 by JPY held in trust, with regular audits. Provides on-chain exposure to JPY for payments, remittances, and DeFi without counterparty risk from unregulated issuers.
highlights: First regulated JPY stablecoin, supervised by NYDFS
Reserves held 1:1 in JPY at regulated Japanese banks
Issued by GMO-Z.com Trust, part of the publicly-listed GMO Internet Group
Useful for FX hedging, remittances, and JPY-denominated DeFi

USTRY.description: Tokenized US Treasury notes providing on-chain yield via Etherfuse
USTRY.summary: USTRY is an Etherfuse Stablebond backed 1:1 by short-to-medium-term US Treasury notes issued by the US Department of the Treasury. The token uses a rebase mechanism, your balance automatically increases as interest accrues daily, so you never need to manually claim yield.
highlights: Backed 1:1 by short-duration US Treasury notes held by a regulated custodian
Yield from the underlying bonds passed through to holders daily
Issued by Etherfuse, a registered tokenization platform for sovereign debt
Redeemable at par in USD against the underlying reserve

TESOURO.description: Tokenized Brazilian government bonds (Letras do Tesouro Nacional)
TESOURO.summary: TESOURO is an Etherfuse Stablebond backed by Brazilian Letras do Tesouro Nacional (LTN), zero-coupon government bonds issued by Brazil's National Treasury. Yield accrues until maturity and is reflected in the token price. Offers on-chain exposure to Brazilian sovereign debt with transparent, 24/7 access.
highlights: Backed by Letras do Tesouro Nacional (LTN), the Brazilian government's zero-coupon bonds
Denominated in BRL, provides on-chain exposure to Brazilian real interest rates
Bonds custodied with regulated Brazilian institutions
Historically among the highest-yielding sovereign instruments in the major economies

CETES.summary: CETES tokens represent Mexican Federal Treasury Certificates (Certificados de la Tesorería) on blockchain, short-term government debt instruments issued by the Mexican federal government and denominated in MXN. Etherfuse's CNBV-cleared Stablebond provides transparent, yield-bearing exposure to CETES with 24/7 trading.
highlights: Backed by Certificados de la Tesorería de la Federación (CETES) issued by the Mexican Treasury
Cleared by Mexico's banking regulator (CNBV) for retail distribution
Tracks short-term MXN interest rates, typical maturities of 28 to 364 days
Daily price accrual reflects yield up to maturity, with no manual claim

BENJI.description: Share of Franklin Templeton's tokenized US government money market fund
BENJI.summary: Each BENJI token is one share of FOBXX, Franklin Templeton's OnChain U.S. Government Money Fund, and was the first US-registered mutual fund to use a public blockchain as its official record of ownership. Stellar was its original issuance chain. The share price is held at $1.00 and yield is distributed as additional tokens. Transfers are restricted to investors Franklin Templeton has onboarded, so BENJI is shown here for reference and cannot be swapped in-app.
highlights: One token equals one share of FOBXX, a '40 Act US government money market fund
First US-registered mutual fund to keep its share register on a public blockchain
Holds US government securities, cash, and fully collateralised repurchase agreements
Transfers are allowlist-gated: acquire and redeem through the Benji app, not on-chain

JTRSY.description: Tokenized short-term US Treasury bill fund, restricted to allowlisted holders
JTRSY.summary: JTRSY is the institutional share class of the Janus Henderson Anemoy Treasury Fund, holding short-dated US Treasury bills. Yield accrues into the token price rather than being paid out, so the price rises over time instead of sitting at $1.00. Transfers are limited to addresses on Centrifuge's allowlist and can be paused by authorized operators, so it is reference-only here. deJTRSY is the freely transferable version of the same underlying fund.
highlights: Backed by short-duration US Treasury bills managed by Janus Henderson / Anemoy
Accumulating: yield is reflected in a rising token price, not in extra tokens
Transfers restricted to allowlisted addresses and pausable by operators
Wrapped as deJTRSY for holders who need a freely transferable version

DEJTRSY.description: Freely transferable wrapper around the tokenized US Treasury bill fund
DEJTRSY.summary: deJTRSY is Centrifuge's deRWA wrapper around JTRSY, the Janus Henderson Anemoy Treasury Fund. It carries the same exposure to short-dated US Treasury bills but drops the allowlist, so it can be held, traded, and used as collateral by anyone on Stellar. This is the version available through Stellar AMM liquidity.
highlights: Same underlying short-duration US Treasury bill portfolio as JTRSY
Freely transferable: no allowlist, tradable and usable as DeFi collateral
Accumulating: yield is reflected in a rising token price
Issued by the Open Market Foundation and pausable by authorized operators

JAAA.description: Tokenized AAA-rated collateralized loan obligations, restricted to allowlisted holders
JAAA.summary: JAAA is the institutional share class of the Janus Henderson Anemoy AAA CLO Fund, holding the AAA-rated tranches of collateralized loan obligations, pools of senior secured corporate loans. The AAA tranche is paid first and absorbs losses last. Transfers are limited to Centrifuge's allowlist, so it is reference-only here; deJAAA is the freely transferable version.
highlights: Holds AAA-rated CLO tranches, the most senior claim on pooled corporate loans
Managed by Janus Henderson, a long-standing manager in the CLO market
Yields more than Treasuries in exchange for corporate credit and liquidity risk
Transfers restricted to allowlisted addresses; wrapped as deJAAA for open access

DEJAAA.description: Freely transferable wrapper around the tokenized AAA-rated CLO fund
DEJAAA.summary: deJAAA is Centrifuge's deRWA wrapper around JAAA, the Janus Henderson Anemoy AAA CLO Fund. It gives the same exposure to AAA-rated collateralized loan obligation tranches without the allowlist, so it can be traded and used as collateral across Stellar DeFi. Note that the AAA rating describes the credit risk of the underlying loans, it is not a peg, and the token price moves.
highlights: Same AAA-rated CLO tranche exposure as JAAA, without transfer restrictions
Freely transferable: tradable on Stellar DEXs and usable as DeFi collateral
AAA refers to credit quality of the loan pool, not to price stability
Issued by the Open Market Foundation and pausable by authorized operators
